Yes
Workable and fair. Having the slice establish and commit real-shape inputs and expected outputs before the red eliminates guesswork during test authoring and prevents review churn across repeated fix rounds. Parametrizing unit tests against five concrete shape families integrates cleanly with our red-green cycle and test doubles without slowing development. The 20-minute counter-metric and 3-card trial protect against slice bloat while providing unambiguous specifications to code against.
